The case of the NIA in brief is as follows: i) The accused persons including the appellants herein, being trained cadres/members of Popular Front of India (PFI), in criminal conspiracy of establishing Islamic Rule in India by 2047, provoked and radicalizing innocent Muslim Youth, recruiting them into PFI, imparting them weapon training in PFT's Terrorist Camps at Heaven Garden Function Hall, Kurnool, to commit violent terrorists activities, such as murdering the targeted persons with knife, sickle, iron rods etc., and the said training was with an intention to strike terror in the minds of people belonging to particular religious community.
